calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period DESC

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period = 11
ORDER BY fiscal_week

SELECT store_key, store_id, store_name, region
FROM dim_store
WHERE region = 'West' AND is_current = TRUE
ORDER BY store_id

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  dp.category,
  ROUND(AVG(fsw.closing_value), 2) AS average_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE ds.region = 'West'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 11
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY dp.category

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS record_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsw.store_key) AS store_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsw.product_key) AS product_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsw.week_ending_date) AS week_count
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE ds.region = 'West'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 11

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_records,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN closing_value IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_values,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN closing_value < 0 THEN 1 END) AS negative_values,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN closing_value = 0 THEN 1 END) AS zero_values
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE ds.region = 'West'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 11

SELECT 
  dp.category,
  ROUND(AVG(fsw.closing_value), 2) AS average_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsw.week_ending_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE ds.region = 'West'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 11
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY dp.category
